summary: Analyzed final runtime source modifications (send-to-gemini.js), state machine workflow evolution (.github/workflows/gemini-chat.yml), supervisor configuration (config.json), work-action approval rulebook (work-action-approval-rulebook.json), and the complete live supervisor lineage log. The runtime shifted from external Google Apps Script forwarding to direct GitHub Actions execution on Node 22, introduced automated deterministic live ground-truth verification (validating filesystem, git objects, and run nonces before supervisory gating), externalized configuration to config.json, and adopted tests/step-3-evaluation.json as the canonical Step 3 artifact. However, the standalone work-action approval rulebook (with safe-word enforcement) remains unreferenced and unenforced in executable runtime code.

facts.text: Commit 9298b84c82cad5ca06a75c182705fd972a4158eb implemented deterministic live ground-truth verification in ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/send-to-gemini.js, inspecting workspace files, git commit/blob objects via child_process.execFileSync, and active run-container nonces.

In send-to-gemini.js (commits 9298b84 and 7cf2f4c), gate_result cannot be PASS if groundTruth.aggregate_status is not PASS, or if ground_truth_verification_eval.supervisor_eval_result is not PASS. Blocking GT statuses are CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, NOT_EXECUTED.

Commit 7cf2f4cb977e5e2c3f9ca09fffbf58448a8a34ac introduced loadSupervisorConfig() reading ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json, dynamically resolving triggerPath, agentsPath, runsRoot, and step3EvalPath, replacing evaluation-tests.md with tests/step-3-evaluation.json for Step 3 prompt context.

The GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/gemini-chat.yml) triggers on push to main affecting ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/nextmessage/nextmessage.json, runs on ubuntu-latest with Node 22, executes send-to-gemini.js directly with secrets/vars, and commits ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs.

Workflow history shows Apps Script forwarding via APPS_SCRIPT_WEB_APP_URL was introduced in commits 22e4a7c/67367e5/240247f but was completely superseded in commit d8a231b (running directly on GitHub Node).

ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json declares external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact pointing to ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json requiring keys ['evaluation_heuristic', 'step3_tsr'].
ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/work-action-approval-rulebook.json defines safe-word authorization requirements, action/pre-action classifications, and ActionPlanReturn JSON schema.
Neither send-to-gemini.js nor config.json nor gemini-chat.yml contains any import, read, reference, or deterministic enforcement logic for work-action-approval-rulebook.json or safe-word validation.

Git lineage in SEG-00020 records run checkpoints committing state, messages, and store files for runs including demo_*, skill_*, agents_schema_migration_*, ground_truth_verification_skill_*, work_action_approval_rulebook_*, and merge_step3_tsr_evaluation_heuristic_*.

interpretations.statement: The Apps Script web app was a temporary transport architecture that has been fully superseded by direct Node.js execution in GitHub Actions.
interpretations.heuristic: Superseded execution paths replaced by direct Node execution in Git history represent retired architectural experiments.

interpretations.statement: Step 3 evaluation method and test corpus were consolidated into tests/step-3-evaluation.json and wired via config.json, superseding evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md in current runtime execution.
interpretations.heuristic: Direct runtime config references establish active canonical artifacts over legacy markdown test files.

interpretations.statement: The Work Action Approval Rulebook was authored and verified as a procedural artifact/run, but was never wired into runtime validation or supervisory prompt logic.
interpretations.heuristic: Presence of a specification or rulebook JSON in the repo without executable wiring or config registration constitutes specification-only status.

interpretations.statement: Live ground-truth verification is deterministically enforced prior to Gemini supervisory evaluation; Gemini cannot pass a candidate if deterministic findings block it.
interpretations.heuristic: Pre-call deterministic checks with gating fail-closed conditions represent deterministic enforcement.

truth_decisions.claim: Gemini Supervisor executes via Google Apps Script web app endpoint.
truth_decisions.explanation: Commit d8a231b and current gemini-chat.yml execute send-to-gemini.js directly on GitHub Node, eliminating APPS_SCRIPT_WEB_APP_URL.

truth_decisions.claim: Evaluation tests are loaded directly from evaluation-tests.md in Step 3 prompt context.
truth_decisions.explanation: Commit 7cf2f4c rewired Step 3 prompt construction to load tests/step-3-evaluation.json via config.json.

truth_decisions.claim: Work-action safe-word approval rulebook is enforced across Gemini Supervisor actions.
truth_decisions.explanation: The rulebook exists as a file (work-action-approval-rulebook.json) and underwent a supervisor run checkpoint, but send-to-gemini.js never loads or validates safe words.

truth_decisions.claim: Deterministic ground-truth verification validates workspace paths, git blobs/commits, and run nonces, blocking PASS transitions on contradiction or non-execution.
truth_decisions.explanation: send-to-gemini.js contains complete git and filesystem inspection functions and fails evalValid() if blocking findings exist or aggregate_status != PASS.

requirement_candidates.name: Live Ground Truth Verification
requirement_candidates.description: Deterministic empirical verification of locators, git shas, and run state nonces before LLM supervisory gating, blocking PASS on unverified claims.

requirement_candidates.name: Configuration Externalization via config.json
requirement_candidates.description: Supervisor runtime must resolve trigger paths, agents documentation, run directory, and step 3 evaluation artifacts through ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json.

requirement_candidates.name: Consolidated Step 3 Evaluation Artifact
requirement_candidates.description: Use tests/step-3-evaluation.json containing evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr as the canonical Step 3 context.

requirement_candidates.name: Work Action Approval and Safe-Word Authorization
requirement_candidates.description: Require user safe-word selection and matching approval before executing actions, with strict action classification and frozen plan scope.

implementation_findings.description: collectGroundTruth() parses returnSchema for evidence records, tests file paths with fs.statSync/fs.readFileSync and git status/ls-files, tests shas via git cat-file, checks run nonces against run container json files, and blocks supervisory pass if aggregate_status !== 'PASS'.
evalValid() enforces supervisory gate response schema, exact reflection of deterministic ground truth findings, and strict PASS/FAIL matching.
loadSupervisorConfig() dynamically configures paths from config.json, throwing runtime errors if missing.
Executes on nextmessage push, runs send-to-gemini.js via Node 22, extracts checkpoint summary from state.json, and commits runs directory.
Contains definitions, JSON schema, and evaluation rules for safe-word authorization, but has zero integration with send-to-gemini.js.

contradictions.description: work-action-approval-rulebook.json asserts that no action is authorized without safe-word approval, but the executable supervisor workflow (gemini-chat.yml and send-to-gemini.js) processes nextmessage.json and executes without checking safe words.

unresolved.description: Whether work-action-approval-rulebook.json was intended to govern future client-side execution planning or if its exclusion from send-to-gemini.js is an incomplete implementation gap.
